id: title:eli-r-ph:drop duplicate symbol set index lower cleanup concurrency

review.posthog_relevance: Database maintenance and migration safety, specifically the removal of redundant database indexes and concurrent index dropping to prevent transaction timeouts or deadlocks.
review.reason: The change removes a redundant database index and adds a comment explaining the redundancy, while also adding a migration to drop an index concurrently. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in database maintenance and migration safety. The removal of redundant indexes reduces storage and write overhead, and the concurrent drop mechanism prevents transaction timeouts.
review.uncertainty: While the code demonstrates the implementation of index removal and dependency tracking, the actual benefit of reduced storage or avoided transaction timeouts depends on the specific database configuration and load, which is not demonstrated in the diff. The tier is assigned based on the implementation of a bounded correctness and maintenance improvement, not on unverified outcomes

observations.limitations: This chunk represents a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed here; this is an observation-only pass.

observations.behavior: Adds a Django migration to drop an index while disabling transactional atomicity.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows dropping a large index without holding a transaction lock, preventing potential transaction timeouts or deadlocks during the drop operation.

observations.behavior: Updates migration dependency tracking to reflect the new migration sequence.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes the dependency chain for database migrations, ensuring the index drop migration runs after the prerequisite settings removal.

observations.behavior: Removes a database index and adds a comment explaining the redundancy with another index.
